"Who are you?" Light asked, fascinated.

"I am Shadow," came a quiet voice. "I am born from your meeting with the solid world. Where you cannot reach, I exist."

Thus, they became eternal companions, dancing across the world, creating the rhythm of day and night.

Myth: In the age before time had a name, Silence reigned over all existence. She was vast and complete, encompassing everything in her perfect stillness. But Silence grew curious about her own nature, for how could she know herself when there was nothing to contrast against her?

From her curiosity, she breathed forth Sound—a single, pure note that rippled through the void. Sound was her opposite: vibrant, moving, alive with energy. At first, Sound sang wildly, creating chaos and discord.

"Why do you struggle?" Silence asked gently.

"Because I fear if I stop, I will disappear into you," Sound replied.

Silence smiled. "But don't you see? I give you space to exist. Without me between your notes, you would be merely noise. And you give me meaning—for what is silence without the memory of sound?"

Understanding bloomed between them. Sound learned to rest, creating rhythm and melody. Silence learned to listen, becoming the canvas for every song.

"My creations disappear like mist," Lyra replied. "I wish to make something permanent, something that endures."

Shadow smiled gently. "Not all beauty must last forever to matter. I myself vanish when Light departs, yet I return each day. Perhaps your dreams are precious because they are fleeting."

Inspired, Lyra began weaving with both light and shadow, creating dreams that taught mortals to cherish temporary moments—a child's laugh, a sunset's glow, a friend's embrace. These dreams felt more real, more meaningful.

When people woke, they couldn't remember the details, but they carried a deeper wisdom: that life's most beautiful gifts are those we cannot hold forever.

And so Lyra learned that impermanence itself could be the greatest gift of all.
